     Update "version" and the lists with each release. -->
version: 0.6.4
tagline: Everyone's damage in the Mau Totem phase, pets in the other faction's world, and cleaner fight lists.

## Fixed
- 🗿 **Mau Totem phase, party damage:** everyone's damage on the waves now counts, including mobs you never hit yourself
- 🏃 **Bosses out of range:** if you run out of range of a boss and your party moves on to the next one, each boss now gets its own fight
- 🐾 **Summons and deaths:** a summon ending no longer counts as you dying
- 👥 **Same player listed twice:** a player who died and came back no longer gets a second row in some fights
- ❔ **"Unknown monster" row:** a stray hit from something the game never names no longer adds a row to your damage list
- 🌍 **Pets from the other faction's world:** a pet whose monster has a twin on the other side now shows its strip on both, so farming in a rift shows your pet's progress
- 💎 **Maxed pets learned from crystals:** a pet that reaches max while you farm now shows as maxed from the crystals its monster drops
